name: Squish
description: Shrinks PDFs, scans and photos on iPhone and iPad to the exact size an upload form asks for (2 MB, 500 KB or any number) and keeps them readable, on device.
terms: Released 19 Nov 2026. Back to $4.99 ($8.99 Family) on Dec 4. One-time purchase, free download with a 7-day trial, no code. US prices; local prices vary.
